CheckTitle: DCS Redis instances have SSL/TLS encryption enabled
Description: Ensure that DCS Redis instances have SSL/TLS encryption enabled for data in transit.
Risk: Redis instances without SSL/TLS encryption transmit data in plaintext, making it vulnerable to interception and tampering on the network.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Distributed Cache Service.
3. Select the instance.
4. Enable SSL/TLS encryption for the instance.

Recommendation.Text: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for DCS Redis instances to encrypt data in transit.

Notes: Checks if DCS Redis instances have SSL/TLS enabled (enable_ssl is not false).
